churches.pastor_credentials: APA priest, Diocese of the Eastern United States
churches.services: Christian Education 9:00 AM; Early Service 9:45 AM; Late Service 11:15 AM

score_notes.christology: APA affirms 39 Articles of Religion + Nicene Creed — Trinitarian Chalcedonian orthodoxy.
score_notes.scripture: APA holds historic Anglican view of Scripture as containing all things necessary to salvation per Article VI; inerrancy affirmed in practice.
score_notes.gender: APA ordains only men to priesthood per 1928 BCP tradition and historic catholic order; male-only orders.
score_notes.leadership: Rector-led parish under Bishop oversight; full episcopal accountability via diocesan structure.
score_notes.soteriology: 39 Articles — salvation by grace alone through faith alone per Articles XI–XIII.
score_notes.cultural: Continuing Anglican bodies (G-3: APA/ACC/ACA) explicitly resist sexual revolution and women's ordination — split from 1976 ECUSA actions.
score_notes.denominational: APA is a Continuing Anglican jurisdiction holding to 1928 BCP, 39 Articles, and historic episcopal order; in full communion with G-3 partners (APA/ACC/ACA).
score_notes.preaching: Liturgical worship anchored in BCP + lectionary; sermons typically expository within liturgical context.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Verify on parish website — varies by congregation; not as systematically emphasized as in Reformed Baptist tradition.
score_notes.mission: Continuing Anglican parishes engage local mission + liturgical formation; small jurisdiction overall but committed to historic orthodoxy.
